organization_release_mirrors_note: Gitea primary, GitHub mirror with identical signed feeds/assets. Feed/asset fetch falls back on network error/timeout/404/5xx only; size/SHA-256/signature mismatch stops. MY_AGENT_UPDATE_MIRRORS=0 disables.
work_kit_note: Server migration: MY_AGENT_WORK_KIT_CATALOG_FEED_URL, MY_AGENT_WORK_KIT_ASSET_URL_TEMPLATE, MY_AGENT_UPDATE_TRUSTED_HOSTS. Empty feed URL = catalog refresh disabled until configured.
